ModMetaData.name: Green Hazard: Toxic Flora and Woodcutting《綠色殺機：毒草與伐木》
ModMetaData.author: NaNa
ModMetaData.description:
English below / 中文說明在下方（請往下捲動）
==================== English ====================
"I sent a pawn to chop wood for a bed, and the axe slipped. Another got a concussion from a falling tree. My grazing cow ate toxic flora and dropped dead."
Make the wilderness dangerous again. Harvesting, grazing and woodcutting now carry a very small, unpredictable risk of accidents. No warnings, just RimWorld.
[ Human: Harvest Allergy ] ・0.2% chance per harvest to trigger an allergic reaction (avg. 1 in 500). ・Reduces breathing and manipulation. ・Recovers naturally in 1-2 days. ・Grants antibodies for 3-5 days after recovery. ・Reduces future allergy chances by 90% during this period.
[ Animal: Grazing Poison ] ・0.08% chance per bite of grass to ingest toxic flora (affects wild animals too). ・Results vary based on probability: - 80% Mild Gastroenteritis: Vomiting and sluggishness; recovers in half a day. - 10% Neurotoxin: Triggers manhunter madness for 12-24 hours. - 10% Lethal Toxin: Condition worsens continuously, fatal in about two days; requires constant veterinary care to suppress. ・Grants adaptation for 3-5 days after recovery, reducing future poison chances by 80%.
[ Woodcutting Accidents ] ・Axe Slip: Chance to cut oneself while chopping trees, causing bleeding and potential infection. ・Falling Tree: Falling trees can crush pawns. ・30% chance to hit the head (causing concussions or knockout), triggering an alert. ・Accident chance scales inversely with Plants skill (Lv.0 1% -> Lv.20 0.2%). ・Accidents leave a record in the health tab, disappearing after 15-30 days.
[ Settings ] ・All 4 features can be toggled individually, and all probabilities are fully adjustable via sliders. ・Reset options available for individual tabs or all default settings. ・Safe to add to existing save games.
==================== 中文 ====================
《绿色杀机：毒草与伐木》
「我叫小人去砍点木头做床，结果斧头打滑大量出血，另一个被倒下的树砸成脑震荡；放出去吃草的牛还吃到了毒草直接猝死。」
让野外不再人畜无害。收获、啃草、砍树，都有极小的概率出事，事前没有征兆。
【人类：收获过敏】 ・每次收获有 0.2% 的概率过敏（约 500 次一次） ・过敏会降低呼吸与操作能力 ・ 1～2 天后自然痊愈 ・痊愈后 3～5 天内有抗体 ・期间再次过敏的概率降低 90%
【动物：啃草中毒】 ・动物每啃一口有 0.08% 的概率中毒（野生动物也会） ・中毒后依概率分为三种结果： - 80% 轻微胃肠炎：呕吐、行动迟缓，半天内自行康复 - 10% 神经毒素：陷入狂暴 12～24 小时 - 10% 剧毒：若持续恶化约两天致死，需兽医治疗才能压制 ・痊愈后 3～5 天内有适应期，期间中毒概率降低 80%
【砍树意外】 ・斧头打滑：砍树时可能割伤自己，处理不当会感染 ・被树砸中：倒木可能砸伤小人 ・其中 30% 砸中头部（脑震荡或昏厥），并触发警报 ・意外概率随种植技能递减（0 级 1% → 20 级 0.2%） ・意外会在健康面板留下记录，15～30 天后消失
【设置】 ・四项功能可各自开关，所有概率都能用滑块调整 ・可只重置单一分页，或一次还原所有默认值 ・可在存档中途加入
